svg.title: Pontes do Bairro
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Pontes do Bairro.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached illustration ONLY as a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: the same premium detailed pixel-art look, crisp small pixels, nuanced dithering, dimensional lighting and cozy Brazilian indie-adventure atmosphere. Retain the SAME Black teenage heroine: dark brown skin, short voluminous curly afro, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE wholly new finished VOICES challenge cover, replacing the whole setting, composition and action with the described scene. Panoramic landscape 20:9, around 1870x841, for a small 640x288 game-selection card. Rich but readable focal hierarchy, clear gameplay storytelling and strong silhouettes. Keep all primary action within the central 75 percent height. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders or UI screenshots. No photorealism, smooth vector shapes or toy 3D. Challenge: Pontes do Bairro. A gorgeous elevated three-quarter view of a gentle turquoise river crossing puzzle. The central composition clearly shows a compact FIVE BY FIVE array of square wooden walkway tiles floating above the river; a readable continuous bent path of connected golden planks crosses from the grassy left bank to the right bank with a couple of right-angle turns. A few other tiles are rotated away from the route to suggest the rotation puzzle. The heroine takes a careful step onto the connected path from the left bank. Clear water, reeds, lily pads, river stones and soft reflections, with lovely town cottages and trees beyond. A small warm golden guide light travels along the connected route, subtle and environmental rather than UI. Bright tranquil afternoon, teal water, honey-colored wood, sage greenery and cream highlights. The bridge tiles and path must dominate the thumbnail, not distant scenery. No arrows or text."}
